title: Hanasato Minori — All Tuckered Out〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
It's so nice out! We couldn't have asked for a better day to throw a disc around!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it is very nice out today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, which makes our shoot getting postponed just that much more unfortunate.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There wasn't much they could do since the place we were going said we couldn't do today. Fortunately, it wasn't canceled. We at least got to reschedule.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so let's have a nice, fun time with Samo today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I really wish we were doing a livestream of this at least...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But you were the one who said we shouldn't stream here since one of the other parkgoers might walk into our frame or our viewers might decide to come partway through.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, let's do our best to make up for that by taking some good pictures and shorts and posting them online.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. Let's take some that'll really make our viewers smile!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, we can play with our disc over here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin our fun disc dog photo shoot!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mind showing us how it's done, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure! But I can't really guarantee anything...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You even said so yourself on our way over. You kept throwing all over the place when you were practicing with Akito and the others, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's okay, Minori. There's no one else near us, so we can go retrieve it wherever it goes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it really veered off sideways...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Don't just stare!
We gotta go get it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow...! I didn't know Samo could run that fast!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, he might be able to catch the disc!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Samo, welcome back!
That was amazing! You really are the best! Come here, boy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're so athletic, Samo!
And I think we just got ourselves an unbelievable pic!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori's throw was also a bit unbelievable...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha... Sorry I couldn't set a better example...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You were gripping the disc really hard it seems, so why don't you try relaxing your hold a bit?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Like this. Keep it flat at chest level, and move your hand straight forward...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess we humans are the only ones who need more practice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to learn how to throw as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, me too! Please teach me how to become better at throwing the disc!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, let's start by passing it to each other.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay. In that case, we should give ourselves some more space.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You take a quick breather, Samo!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. The way he tilts his head is so cute.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I didn't think he'd work so hard to catch a disc that wasn't thrown by his owner... I can't tell if he's a kind dog or if he's just that eager.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: His personality may be a reflection of his owner's.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, Haruka! Airi!
Am I good here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Samo!
Shizuku and I are gonna practice with that! Give it back!
